statement: An externally learned remote neighbor exists before movement
support: Pre-move Leaf2 kernel snapshots show robot entry extern_learn, NOARP and protocol zebra; Zebra reports remote via 10.0.0.1
contradiction_or_limit: Not every microsecond before movement is sampled

statement: Initial robot ARP reaches Leaf2 while that entry exists
support: Immediate-01 pre-stimulus snapshot shows external NOARP; ARP appears on robot and Leaf2 bridge before first recorded failed/deleted neighbor. Access-01 directly captures earlier natural ARP on eth-host11 before the recorded deletion; its socket drop counter is zero
contradiction_or_limit: Snapshots and userspace notification receive timestamps do not establish the exact kernel state at frame arrival; other matched runs lack a final socket-drop count

statement: The kernel does not convert that entry to a local learned neighbor
support: Immediate-01 shows no local-neighbor notification before recorded FAILED/DEL; local IP absent in later samples. Upstream v6.8 non-administrative update guard rejects old NUD_NOARP
contradiction_or_limit: No running-kernel function-entry/return trace, netlink loss proof for matched trial or exact state at the update; Ubuntu source identity not established

statement: Zebra therefore does not originate local MAC/IP Type-2
support: In four immediate and four no-announcement runs local IP and Leaf2-sent MAC/IP were not observed while local MAC was sampled
contradiction_or_limit: No direct trace proves Zebra received or did not receive a local-neighbor event or that H3 was necessary for H4; capture completeness limited
evidence: intervention-trials.csv; bgp-type2-transitions.csv; zebra source in source-analysis.md

statement: Withdrawal of old route removes Leaf5 /32
support: Captured old MAC/IP withdrawal and Leaf5 netlink /32 deletion correlate across runs
contradiction_or_limit: No direct BGP-to-Zebra-to-kernel causality trace; alternate route selection or competing route effects not excluded

statement: Fallback sends selected controller packets to a leaf that cannot deliver them
support: Immediate-01 seq60 goes Leaf5→Leaf3 and times out without a captured arrival at Leaf2/robot
contradiction_or_limit: Exact drop location or inability not proven; repeated-01 seq44 reaches Leaf3 then Leaf2 and robot replies, so incorrect first VTEP need not lose traffic

statement: Later successful neighbor learning causes MAC/IP advertisement and /32 restoration
support: Delayed-02 ARP capture, Leaf2 local STALE event, Leaf2 MAC/IP, Leaf5 /32 via Leaf2 and probe recovery form a time-ordered chain
contradiction_or_limit: No direct internal tracing or randomized isolated intervention proves necessity or causality; delayed-01 recovered before scheduled send
